description_en: Queries the details of a Cassandra instance
name: DescribeCluster

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
The Unified Auto Renewal Cycle.

If the cluster is purchased on a monthly basis, the auto-renewal epoch is 1 month.
If the cluster is purchased on a yearly basis, the auto-renewal epoch is 1 year (12 months).

Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
AutoRenewPeriod.description_zh:
自动续费周期。

按月购买：则自动续费周期为 1 个月。
按年购买：则自动续费周期为 1 年（12个月）。

按量付费实例无到期时间

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values: true/false.
Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
是否自动续费，可取值：true/false
按量付费实例无到期时间

ClusterName.description_en:
The cluster name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character. The name can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
ClusterName.description_zh:
集群名称。

长度为2-128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字，‘.’，‘_’或‘-’

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 集群创建时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the cluster. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ExpireTime.description_zh: 集群到期时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

IsLatestVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the current minor version is the latest version
IsLatestVersion.description_zh: 当前小版本是否为最新版本

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode. Valid values:

None: not locked.
Expired: locked because the cluster subscription has expired.
DiskFull: locked because the disk is full
LockMode.description_zh:
锁定模式：

None：未锁定
Expired：集群订阅到期锁定
DiskFull：磁盘已满锁定

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O&M window for the instance. Format: HH:mmZ (UTC)
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 实例运维结束时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O&M window for the instance. Format: HH:mmZ (UTC)
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 实例运维开始时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC 通用标准时，以Z来标识）

MajorVersion.description_en: The major version number of the cluster

MinorVersion.description_en: The minor version number of the cluster

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型，可取值：

Subscription：包年包月
PayAsYouGo：按量付费

按量付费实例无到期时间

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs

Status.description_en:
The running status of the cluster. Valid values:

Creating: being created
CreateFailed: failed to be created
Running: running
Deleting: being deleted
DeleteFailed: failed to be deleted
Deleted: deleted
Status.description_zh:
集群运行状态，可取值示例：

Creating：创建中
CreateFailed：创建失败
Running：运行中
Deleting：删除中
DeleteFailed：删除失败
Deleted：已删除
